item.title: Gates Foundation Pledges $1 Billion to Combat A.I. Inequality

item.title: California’s Governor Signs Landmark Online Child Safety Bills
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a bill that prohibits social media platforms from providing addictive features to users under 16, the first law of its kind in the nation.
item.dc:creator: Cecilia Kang and Laurel Rosenhall
item.media:credit: Eric Ryan Anderson for The New York Times
item.media:description: Gov. Gavin Newsom’s actions follow a series of social media trials this year, in which thousands of teenagers, schools and states have accused Meta, Snap, TikTok and YouTube of hooking young users with products being compared to cigarettes.

item.media:description: The report Anthropic published on Thursday cataloged a litany of misuses of its A.I. models, including the chatbot Claude, over the past eight months.
